Rishi / Ben — reviewed the attachments. High-level legal position below; inline comments are in the doc (Velox_Fee_Schedule_Redline_v2.docx).

1) Indemnity cap: our standard MSA cap is 3x fees (annual) or $5M, whichever is greater. Velox asked about removing operational exceptions — we should keep the existing carveouts for gross negligence and wilful misconduct. If Velox pushes to lower the cap, we should ask for reciprocal commercial concessions (higher commitment / longer term).

2) Data handling (Dedicated): add a sentence clarifying that customer-provided models/data remain customer-owned and that we will not use customer tokens for training by default. This is a small insertion and should be acceptable.

3) Change-order clause: proposed language in the doc lets either party propose capacity changes with a 30-day notice and written order form amendment. It also allows for pro-rata billing for mid-period adds. That should satisfy procurement.

4) Discounts / credits: onboarding credit is fine; confirm exact dollar cap. For any >15% cumulative discount across license fees we need approval from finance. Monica (cc) can confirm budget/approval process.

If you want, I can prepare a clean MSA excerpt to send alongside the order form to speed Velox legal review. Otherwise the tracked changes in the doc should work.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

--
Inline: see comments on indemnity (p.2) and data handling insertion (p.4).
